canonical.behaviour: Offer #3 (agreements 3 and 4) plus agreement 5 (T10): every /spar debate ends with a usable result. Your consequential choices are asked during the debate (in batches of up to 4, each saying what it changes) until each is answered, deferred by you or named as blocking; nothing is left as a to-do. The last joint check judges fixed versions, so it can't produce new unchecked ones; if the models still disagree, you see both approaches and can take one or leave it open, recorded as your choice. The short result comes first (outcome, whether you can proceed, the recommendation, blockers, your decisions, where it is saved), and only then the save question; outside a task it says "Not saved yet". The top line is one plain bold Spar: line, shown once. A save keeps the exact final texts. Approving this offer also agrees to agreement 5.

no git commit or push; the release is a separate step
no version bump or CHANGELOG entry
the main checkout D:/workflow-axa, the installed plugin and the Codex copies stay untouched
